title: Where does the next record live?
hook: A lookup finds one leaf; a range needs a way onward.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Answer a B+tree range scan by following linked leaves after the initial lookup.

misconception: Every record in a range needs another root-to-leaf lookup.
objective: Answer a B+tree range scan by following linked leaves after the initial lookup.

claims.text: Separators route the first lookup, then leaf links continue the range scan. Internal separators are navigation copies, so counting them again would duplicate stored keys.
